in_marathi.name: Rupendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's red form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rupa means form and Indra means lord. Rupendra means Lord with a beautiful form, specifically referring to Lord Shiva in his red form. It is also a name of Lord Vishnu in some Puranas.
